children: Vertiv announced an agreement to acquire King Environmental Services to expand its fluid management and load-testing services into EMEA, with closing expected in Q4 2026.
Entered definitive agreement to acquire King Environmental Services Ltd., a Europe-based fluid management and load-testing specialist.
Transaction expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 and financial terms were not disclosed; deal not expected to be material.
Acquisition extends Vertiv’s thermal and fluid management services into EMEA, building on its 2025 PurgeRite acquisition in North America.
Combining capabilities aims to improve commissioning, fluid quality, thermal load testing and lifecycle support for high-density and AI-driven infrastructure.
